Adjustment for under-1 diarrheal deaths that are missed due to late enrollments
rows.explainer:
This is a rough adjustment.

- New Incentives enrolls ~14% of infants after 6 months (as of 2023). ORSZ delivered through the program would not address diarrheal episodes that happen during this period.

- IHME data shows that just over 54-57% of diarrheal incidents in children <1 occur when they’re <6 months of age. See the "GBD estimates_ORS" tab.

- However, we expect New Incentives will still deliver the same number of ORSZ co-packs to caregivers who are enrolled on a delayed schedule (i.e. caregivers would still receive 3 ORS co-packs at alternative visits).

- IHME reports ~1.1-1.7 diarrheal incidents in children 12-23 months of age (compared to ~2-2.3 for children <1 year). So, while the diarrheal burden is lower in the slightly older age group, we expect any ORSZ delivered by New Incentives roughly between the 0-23 months age range to still avert a meaningful share of deaths.

-
